notes:
**CHR-1146 — Use Cases tab: world, state, triggers and branches** (ADR-011, Use-Cases-Spec v2.0.5 §3.4–§3.9, §6, §11). Sample domain: home insurance renewal (personas Maria, Jon, Insurer North; entities Leo, Household liability policy). **Screens** - Detail: `usecases-detail-world` (trigger line, World card incl. an unknown constellation, Starting state table, branch lanes, warnings at their targets) · `usecases-detail-world-variant` (diff of constellations, trigger, state incl. unset and inherited rows, branches incl. emptied; coverage with World/Personas column groups). - Pool: `usecases-world` (new sub-tab World: entities, relationship types, constellations) · `usecases-world-empty` (no or empty `world.json`). - Dialogs: `usecases-entity-dialog`, `usecases-relationship-type-dialog`, `usecases-constellation-dialog`, `usecases-edit-dialog-world` (trigger Action, World, Starting state, Branches), `usecases-edit-dialog-trigger-state`, `usecases-edit-dialog-branch`, `usecases-edit-dialog-branch-invalid` (errors, replace_branch mode), `usecases-edit-dialog-variant-world`, `usecases-generate-dialog-constellations`; changed: `usecases-edit-dialog` (step Via), `usecases-edit-dialog-persona` (Kind), `usecases-generate-dialog` (target switch), `usecases-dimension-dialog` (Describes = scope). - List / mapping: `usecases-list-world` (Constellation filter, count pills, kind icons on persona chips) · `usecases-mapping-branches` (branch numbering). **Design system** — new components `uc-actor-kind`, `uc-condition-chip`, `uc-branch-end`, `uc-relation-row`, `uc-trait-chip`; new variants `uc-avatar entity / entity-sm`, `uc-diff-badge emptied`, `uc-frame-no branch / branch-selected`, `chrome-tab compact / compact-active`, `uc-list-row counts / counts-selected / constellations-only`; new patterns `uc-branch-lane`, `uc-state-table`. Usage notes on each. **Cross-screen rules** 1. **Participants:** personas are round colour avatars (+ kind icon after the name), entities are square neutral avatars with their type, `system` is the chip icon. One id namespace; `system` is reserved. 2. **Branch numbering:** `.` (2A.1); no fork number before the first step (A.1). Dashed numbers = branch steps, everywhere (detail lanes, editor, mapping). 3. **Conditions** are documentation: chips show subject.property, operator symbol (word as accessible name; editors use the words), value. Never coloured by truth. **Value parse rule** (state and condition values): `true`/`false` → boolean, a plain number → number, else string (dates stay strings); quotes force a string; "is one of" takes a comma list, each item parsed the same way. 4. **Every branch lane is always shown**; Artisign never picks one. Every rejoin target says "Branch … continues here". 5. **World warnings sit at their target** (§6 grammar): `/` under the step, `/branch:` in the lane, `/…/state:.

` on the chip or row, `/trigger` on the trigger line, `/constellation:` on the card; pool targets on the pool entry. Amber, never blocking; a variant repeats no base warning but keeps the inherited row. Copy is neutral ("Add it to the world", "Create it in World"). 6. **Variant colours** as chr1104 (Changed amber, Added green, Removed dashed red with struck base, From base neutral) plus **Emptied** (dashed amber) for `branch_empty`; **Unset** state is a removed row. A variant trigger replaces the trigger whole. 7. **Scope:** dimensions are Personas or Constellations; dialogs, coverage and generate only offer the matching ones. A stored trait of the other scope still shows, labelled with its scope. 8. **Inverses are never inferred** (§3.5): "Inverse label · optional, never derived"; the pool shows "None" when empty. 9. Native controls throughout (CHR-1097): selects, checkboxes, radios, tables with row headers; repeated rows are `role="group"` with a numbered accessible name and `aria-describedby` to their warning. 10. **Delete** in the entity, relationship type and constellation dialogs (danger text, asks first, names where it is used). **Hard save rules (errors, block Save/Apply; decision chr1103).** Field gets `mono-error` / `error` + `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby` to a danger hint with the error icon; the footer shows "N errors." plus the first one, `role="status"`; the primary button is disabled with the same text as `title`. Copy: - Duplicate (subject, property) in base or variant state: "Leo · age is already set above. Change that row instead." - Branch without a condition: "Add at least one condition. A branch without one cannot be saved." — without a step: "Add at least one step. A branch without one cannot be saved." - "is one of" without a list: "Add at least one value, separated by commas." - Step id collision (one namespace across main flow and branches): "accept is already step 3 of the main flow. Give this step another id." (or "… step 2B.1 of branch 2B …"). - Malformed `at`: "Use a date (2027-01-01) or a date and time (2027-01-01T09:00)." - Entity id `system`: "system is reserved for Artisign itself. Pick another id." - Trigger with an actor plus state/at: not reachable in the UI (the State or time mode has no Actor field). - Branch id in replace_branch: read-only (locked value, "A replaced branch keeps its id."), so it cannot change. Drawn: `usecases-edit-dialog-branch-invalid` (no condition, step id collision, read-only id). The others follow the same pattern and are specified in the notes of their dialogs. **Editable fields that must survive a save:** relationship `note` (constellation dialog, Note column), step `via` (step rows in the use case and branch editors). **Known drawing limits:** the World tab and compact sub-nav are drawn on the chr-1146 screens only; older Use Cases screens keep the three-tab sub-nav until built.
